episodes.title: I Exist
episodes.summary: Sunlit promise — and the darkest danger — lies around each bend when new director Lisa meets a powerful producer. But he wants more than she expects.

episodes.title: Hair of the Dog
episodes.summary: Rocked by a bizarre birth and thirsty for revenge, Lisa commits herself fully to the curse despite hateful visions. Roy unexpectedly steps up to help.

episodes.title: Roman Candle
episodes.summary: Lost in Boro's jungle and astonished by her rampaging plant, Lisa gets an unsavory proposition from Lou. First comes a screening — then the screams.

episodes.title: Tadpole Smoothie
episodes.summary: If a weird door in the floor opens, why not go down it? As chaos reigns, Lou confronts Lisa. Clues to Boro's past materialize. A new opening appears.

episodes.title: Jennifer
episodes.summary: You can't go home again: A wild woman reconnects with her family. Lou finds a frantic Mary and eyes a way to get back at Lisa. The prodigal son returns.

episodes.title: Milk Bath
episodes.summary: Mary goes deeper to realize an uncompromising vision. Boro shares her tale. Lisa perks up. Lou pushes for an ending, but will he get the one he wants?

episodes.title: Egg
episodes.summary: A desperate Lisa kisses the toad, but blood-sex magic holds the key. Lou and Jonathan have a moment. A savage spirit accomplishes the impossible.

episodes.title: Bodies
episodes.summary: Lisa tries to finally get answers. She's made a lot of enemies on her way to the top, and she still has scores to settle. Who will make it out alive?
